### [hyprland-wiki/configuring/core/_index.md] _index
> [!WARNING]
> The default config is not complete and does not include every Hyprland option or feature.
> For every configuration option, see the pages linked from this wiki section.

The config is located in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hypr/hyprland.lua`.
In most cases, that maps to `~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua`.

You can pass arguments while starting Hyprland (`start-hyprland`), but you must pass your arguments after `--`.
For instance, to use `--config` (or `-c`) to make Hyprland load a non-default config, you might use `start-hyprland -- --config ~/myRices/medium_rare/hyprland.lua`.

If no configuration exists, Hyprland will create an [example config](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/main/example/hyprland.lua).
Remove `hl.config({ autogenerated = true })` to remove the autogenerated warning banner.

Configuration is reloaded when changes to files are detected.
To reload manually, use `hyprctl reload`.

To get information (class, size, tags, etc.), use:
- `hyprctl clients` to show all windows
- `hyprctl activewindow` to show only the active window

# =============================================================================
#  settings.conf — THE single place for every user-tweakable value
# =============================================================================
#  Read by:
#    * Hyprland (hypr/lib/settings.lua parses this file)
#    * every shell script (they `source` it through hypr/scripts/lib.sh)
#    * the theming engine (fonts / radius are injected into every template)
#
#  Syntax: shell-compatible  KEY="value"  lines. Comments start with '#'.
#  Only $HOME and ${HOME} are expanded on the Lua side, so keep values simple.
#
#  Runtime toggles (animations, blur, gaps, gamemode, monitor profile) are
#  saved in ~/.local/state/inkpaw/toggles.conf and OVERRIDE these values.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Applications
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TERMINAL="kitty"
# Command prefix that runs a TUI in a floating terminal (class matched by a window rule)
TERMINAL_FLOAT="kitty --class floating-tui -e"
BROWSER="firefox"
FILEMANAGER="nautilus --new-window"
EDITOR_GUI="gnome-text-editor"
CALCULATOR="gnome-calculator"
# spotlight = sectioned list (spotlight/), walker = Walker
LAUNCHER="spotlight"
# Settings: app = settings window (libadwaita), rofi = rofi menu
SETTINGS_UI="app"
AUDIO_MIXER="pavucontrol"
BLUETOOTH_MANAGER="blueman-manager"

# Personal apps (bound in hypr/conf/keybinds/apps.lua)
APP_CHAT="discord"
APP_MUSIC="spotify-launcher"
APP_TEAMS="teams-for-linux"

# Terminal (kitty) — empty = keep the value of your own kitty.conf
KITTY_FONT=""
KITTY_FONT_SIZE=""
# 0.0 – 1.0 (1 = opaque)
KITTY_OPACITY=""
KITTY_PADDING=""
# block | beam | underline
KITTY_CURSOR=""

# File manager preferences — empty = leave as is
# true | false
FILES_SHOW_HIDDEN=""
# list | grid
FILES_VIEW=""

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Keyboard / input
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MOD="SUPER"
KB_LAYOUT="fr"
KB_VARIANT=""
KB_OPTIONS="grp:alt_shift_toggle"
MOUSE_SENSITIVITY="0"
NATURAL_SCROLL="true"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitors (see hypr/monitors/*.lua for the profiles)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MONITOR_LAPTOP="eDP-2"
MONITOR_EXTERNAL="HDMI-A-1"
# Where the external screen sits relative to the laptop: left | right | above | below
MONITOR_EXTERNAL_SIDE="right"
# Profile used until you pick one with the monitor menu: auto | extended | laptop-only | external-only | mirror
MONITOR_PROFILE="auto"
# Disable the laptop panel when the lid closes and an external screen is connected
LID_SWITCH_HANDLING="true"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Look & feel (Hyprland)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GAPS_IN="6"
GAPS_OUT="12"
BORDER_SIZE="2"
BORDER_ANGLE="45"
# Slowly rotating gradient border (HyDE-style); small GPU cost
BORDER_ANIMATE="false"
ROUNDING="10"
ACTIVE_OPACITY="0.92"
INACTIVE_OPACITY="0.84"
BLUR="true"
BLUR_SIZE="7"
BLUR_PASSES="3"
SHADOW="true"
# soft = blurred drop shadow | hard = solid offset ink shadow (hand-drawn look)
SHADOW_STYLE="soft"
# Focused window border: gradient (3 accents) | ink (solid text color)
BORDER_STYLE="gradient"
ANIMATIONS="true"
# Animation preset file in hypr/conf/animations/ (without .lua): smooth | md3 | fast | none
ANIMATION_PRESET="smooth"
LAYOUT="dwindle"

CURSOR_THEME="Bibata-Modern-Ice"
CURSOR_SIZE="24"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UI tokens (injected into Waybar / swaync / walker / rofi / wlogout templates)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Text font (bar, menus, notifications, launcher, lock screen)
FONT_FAMILY="Google Sans Flex"
# Monospace font (Spotlight list, code)
MONO_FONT="JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"
# Icon font (Nerd Font glyphs used as fallback for icons)
ICON_FONT="CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font"
FONT_SIZE="12"
UI_RADIUS="12"
UI_BORDER="1"
# Background opacity of bars / panels (0.0 – 1.0)
UI_OPACITY="0.72"
# Title font (big headings, workspace numbers in skinned looks); empty = FONT_FAMILY
DISPLAY_FONT=""

# Interface style ("skin"): default | encre (ink & parchment, hand-drawn, cats).
# It only changes the fonts, the look of the apps / menus and the top bar:
# colors, wallpaper, window borders / shadows / gaps and the desktop cat stay yours.
# Change it with  hyprtheme/skin.sh apply <name>  (or Settings → Appearance):
# the skin writes its own fonts / bar / borders (hyprtheme/skins/<name>/skin.conf)
# and the previous values come back with  skin.sh apply default.
UI_SKIN="default"
# Cat peeking from the bottom of the screen (deskpet/), click it to hear it
DESKTOP_PET="false"
# moumoute | gribouille | biscotte | pate | clafoutis | croquette
DESKTOP_PET_CAT="gribouille"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bar (Waybar) — everything here can also be changed from the settings menu
# (SUPER+CTRL+S → Bar). The config is generated by waybar/build.py.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# top | bottom
BAR_POSITION="top"
# Monitors showing the bar: "*" = all, or names separated by spaces ("eDP-2 HDMI-A-1")
BAR_OUTPUTS="*"
# Where the capsules go: center (all in the middle) | split (session left,
# clock center, status+system right) | left | right | custom (BAR_LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT)
BAR_LAYOUT="center"
BAR_LEFT="session"
BAR_CENTER="time"
BAR_RIGHT="status system"
# true = put every capsule inside ONE single pill (thin separators between groups)
BAR_SINGLE_CAPSULE="false"
# Look: capsules (floating pills) | floating (one rounded bar) | solid (edge to edge) |

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/env.lua — environment variables
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")
local HOME = S.paths.home

-- PATH: user binaries ---------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("PATH", HOME .. "/.local/bin:" .. HOME .. "/.cargo/bin:" .. (os.getenv("PATH") or ""))

-- Wayland session -------------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP", "Hyprland")
hl.env("XDG_SESSION_TYPE", "wayland")
hl.env("XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP", "Hyprland")
hl.env("DESKTOP_SESSION", "Hyprland")

-- Toolkits --------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("GDK_BACKEND", "wayland,x11,*")
hl.env("GDK_SCALE", "1")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "wayland;xcb")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME", "qt6ct")
hl.env("QT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_WINDOWDECORATION", "1")
hl.env("CLUTTER_BACKEND", "wayland")
hl.env("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "wayland")

-- Electron / browsers -----------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("OZONE_PLATFORM", "wayland")
hl.env("ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT", "wayland")
hl.env("MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND", "1")

-- Fonts: the system config + hyprtheme/fonts (bundled OFL fonts of the skins)
hl.env("FONTCONFIG_FILE", S.paths.theme .. "/fonts/fonts.conf")

-- Cursor ----------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("XCURSOR_THEME", S.str("CURSOR_THEME", "Adwaita"))
hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", S.str("CURSOR_SIZE", "24"))
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", S.str("CURSOR_SIZE", "24"))

-- XWayland: no blurry scaling
hl.config({ xwayland = { force_zero_scaling = true } })

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/look-and-feel.lua — gaps, borders, rounding, opacity, blur, shadows
-- =============================================================================
--  Numbers come from settings.conf; colors from the generated theme.
--  GAMEMODE (toggled with SUPER+ALT+G) strips every effect for performance.
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")
local C = require("lib.colors")

local game = S.bool("GAMEMODE", false)
-- "ink" border / "hard" shadow: the hand-drawn look of the encre skin
local ink  = S.str("BORDER_STYLE", "gradient") == "ink"
local hard = S.str("SHADOW_STYLE", "soft") == "hard"

local active_border = ink and C.rgba("on_surface", "ff") or
    -- 3-accent gradient on the focused window (rotates if BORDER_ANIMATE)
    { colors = { C.rgba("a1", "ff"), C.rgba("a3", "ff"), C.rgba("a5", "ff") },
      angle = S.num("BORDER_ANGLE", 45) }

hl.config({
    general = {
        gaps_in     = game and 0 or S.num("GAPS_IN", 10),
        gaps_out    = game and 0 or S.num("GAPS_OUT", 20),
        border_size = game and 1 or S.num("BORDER_SIZE", 2),
        col = {
            active_border   = active_border,
            inactive_border = ink and C.rgba("on_surface", "99") or C.rgba("outline_variant", "40"),
        },
        resize_on_border = true,
        allow_tearing    = false,
        layout           = S.str("LAYOUT", "dwindle"),
    },

    decoration = {
        rounding           = game and 0 or S.num("ROUNDING", 10),
        rounding_power     = 2,
        active_opacity     = game and 1.0 or S.num("ACTIVE_OPACITY", 1.0),
        inactive_opacity   = game and 1.0 or S.num("INACTIVE_OPACITY", 0.9),
        fullscreen_opacity = 1.0,

        -- soft = blurred drop shadow; hard = solid ink block offset down-right
        shadow = {
            enabled        = (not game) and S.bool("SHADOW", true),
            sharp          = hard,
            range          = hard and 1 or 28,
            render_power   = hard and 1 or 3,
            offset         = hard and "5 5" or "0 6",
            color          = hard and C.rgba("shadow", "ff") or C.rgba("shadow", "45"),
            color_inactive = hard and C.rgba("shadow", "99") or C.rgba("shadow", "20"),
        },

        blur = {
            enabled           = (not game) and S.bool("BLUR", true),
            size              = S.num("BLUR_SIZE", 4),
            passes            = S.num("BLUR_PASSES", 4),
            new_optimizations = true,
            ignore_opacity    = true,
            xray              = false,
            noise             = 0.012,
            contrast          = 0.9,
            brightness        = 0.85,
            vibrancy          = 0.18,
        },
    },

    misc = {
        background_color = C.rgba("surface", "ff"),
    },
})

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/monitors.lua — loads the active monitor profile
-- =============================================================================
--  The profile name comes from MONITOR_PROFILE (settings.conf), overridden by
--  the monitor menu (SUPER+SHIFT+M), which saves it in the state toggles file.
--  Profiles live in hypr/monitors/<name>.lua.
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")

local profile = S.str("MONITOR_PROFILE", "auto")

-- In the nested test session the real outputs don't exist: always use "auto".
if S.test_mode then profile = "auto" end

local ok, err = pcall(require, "monitors." .. profile)
if not ok then
    print("[monitors] profile '" .. profile .. "' failed (" .. tostring(err) .. "), using auto")
    require("monitors.auto")
end

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/gestures.lua — touchpad gestures (kept from your ML4W setup)
-- =============================================================================

-- 3 fingers vertical: switch workspace
hl.gesture({ fingers = 3, direction = "vertical", action = "workspace" })

-- 3 fingers horizontal: scroll-move (scrolling layout)
hl.gesture({ fingers = 3, direction = "horizontal", action = "scroll_move", scale = 0.9 })

-- 4 fingers pinch out / in: fullscreen on / off
hl.gesture({ fingers = 4, direction = "pinchout", action = function()
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ action = "set" }))
end })
hl.gesture({ fingers = 4, direction = "pinchin", action = function()
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ action = "unset" }))
end })

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/autostart.lua — services started once when Hyprland starts
-- =============================================================================
--  One entry per service. Set `enabled = false` (or delete the line) to skip
--  one. `host = true` marks services that touch the host session (systemd env,
--  portals, polkit, idle/suspend): they are skipped in the ./test.sh nested
--  session so the test never interferes with your real desktop.
-- =============================================================================
local S  = require("lib.settings")
local sc = S.script

local services = {
    -- Session plumbing ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- XDG_CONFIG_HOME is exported too when set (SDDM "inkpaw" session), so
    -- D-Bus-activated apps (swaync, portals…) read the same config as the session.
    { name = "systemd-env", host = true,
      cmd = "dbus-update-activation-environment --systemd WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE"
            .. (os.getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") and " XDG_CONFIG_HOME" or "") },
    { name = "portals",     host = true,
      cmd = "systemctl --user restart xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland xdg-desktop-portal" },
    { name = "polkit",      host = true, cmd = "/usr/lib/polkit-gnome/polkit-gnome-authentication-agent-1" },
    { name = "cursor",      cmd = "hyprctl setcursor " .. S.str("CURSOR_THEME", "Adwaita") .. " " .. S.str("CURSOR_SIZE", "24") },

    -- Desktop ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    { name = "wallpaper-daemon", cmd = sc("wallpaper-daemon.sh") },
    { name = "theme-restore",    cmd = S.paths.theme .. "/theme.sh restore" },   -- wallpaper + palette
    { name = "apps-config",      cmd = sc("apps-config.sh") },                    -- kitty settings file
    { name = "waybar",           cmd = sc("waybar.sh") .. " start" },
    -- explicit paths: if swaync were D-Bus-activated it would read ~/.config instead
    { name = "notifications",    cmd = sc("notifications.sh") .. " start" },
    { name = "osd",              cmd = sc("osd.sh") .. " server" },               -- picks the skin style
    -- the cat peeking from the bottom of the screen (only when DESKTOP_PET=true)
    { name = "deskpet",          cmd = sc("deskpet.sh") .. " start" },
    -- quick panel kept in memory (hidden) so the bar buttons open it instantly
    { name = "quickpanel",       cmd = sc("quickpanel.sh") .. " --daemon" },
    -- encre menus kept in memory too (power, cheat sheet, themes, wallpapers)
    { name = "resident-menus",   cmd = sc("resident.sh") .. " all --daemon" },
    -- 4-step welcome window, shown once (until "Ne plus afficher" is ticked)
    { name = "welcome",          cmd = sc("welcome.sh") .. " --first" },

    -- Launcher backend (Elephant) + Walker service for instant opening -------------
    { name = "elephant",         cmd = "elephant" },
    { name = "walker-service",   cmd = "walker --gapplication-service" },

    -- Idle management (switches AC / battery timeouts automatically) ----------------
    { name = "idle",             host = true, cmd = sc("idle.sh") .. " watch" },

    -- Low-battery notifications (laptop + mouse / headset…)
    { name = "battery-alert",    cmd = sc("battery-alert.sh") .. " watch" },
}

-- On exit, drop XDG_CONFIG_HOME from the systemd/D-Bus activation env so a
-- following ML4W session never inherits it.
hl.on("hyprland.shutdown", function()
    if os.getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") and not S.test_mode then
        os.execute("systemctl --user unset-environment XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    end
end)

hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    for _, s in ipairs(services) do
        if s.enabled ~= false and not (S.test_mode and s.host) then
            hl.exec_cmd(s.cmd)
        end
    end
end)

})

    no_focus = true,
})

-- AI assistant: a tall window docked on one side (AI_SIDE, AI_WIDTH). aichat.py
-- re-sends this rule at each opening with the exact geometry of the tiled
-- area (hyprctl eval) and widens the outer gap of the workspace, so tiled
-- windows move aside; the values below are only the first-guess fallback. ----
do
    local S   = require("lib.settings")
    local gap = S.num("GAPS_OUT", 12)
    local bar = S.num("BAR_MARGIN", 6) + 41 + gap          -- the bar + its margin + a gap
    local top, bottom = bar, gap
    if S.str("BAR_POSITION", "top") == "bottom" then top, bottom = gap, bar end
    local x = S.str("AI_SIDE", "right") == "left" and tostring(gap)
              or string.format("(monitor_w-window_w-%d)", gap)
    hl.window_rule({
        name  = "aichat",
        match = { class = "^(dev.inkpaw.AIChat)$" },
        float = true,
        size  = string.format("%d (monitor_h-%d)", S.num("AI_WIDTH", 420), top + bottom),
        move  = string.format("%s %d", x, top),
        opacity = "1.0 override 1.0 override",
    })
end

-- Settings window: always fully opaque (readability over the blur) -------------------
hl.window_rule({
    name  = "hypr-settings-opaque",
    match = { class = "^(dev.inkpaw.(Settings|Welcome))$" },
    opacity = "1.0 override 1.0 override",
})

## 🖥️ **Hyprland — Configuration Inkpaw (Laptop + Écran externe)**

### **Architecture**
Configuration modulaire en Lua, organisée par fonctionnalités dans `hypr/conf/`. Le point d'entrée unique est `hypr/hyprland.lua` qui charge tous les modules via `require()`.

---

### **📦 Modules Principaux**

#### **1. Environnement (`conf/env.lua`)**
- Variables Wayland : `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=Hyprland`, `GDK_BACKEND=wayland`
- Toolkits : GTK/Qt/KDE Wayland, Electron Ozone
- Curseur : thème Bibata/Adwaita, taille 24px
- XWayland : scaling forcé à zéro (pas de flou)

#### **2. Moniteurs (`conf/monitors.lua`)**
Profil dynamique via `hypr/monitors/*.lua` :
- **auto** (défaut) : gestion automatique des écrans
- **extended** : laptop + écran externe en étendu
- **laptop-only** / **external-only** : profil dédié
- **mirror** : duplication

#### **3. Entrées (`conf/input.lua`)**
- Clavier : layout `fr`, variante vide, options `grp:alt_shift_toggle`
- Souris : suivi 1 fenêtre, sensibilité ajustable
- Touchpad : défilement naturel activé

#### **4. Apparence (`conf/look-and-feel.lua`)**
- **Gaps** : interne 6px, externe 12px (réduit en gamemode)
- **Borders** : taille 2px, angle 45°, style gradient (3 accents)
- **Arrondi** : 10px (0 en gamemode)
- **Flou** : activé, taille 7px, 3 passes
- **Ombres** : style "soft" (flouté), activé
- **Opacité** : active 0.92, inactive 0.84

#### **5. Animations (`conf/animations/`)**
Présents : `smooth`, `md3`, `fast`, `none`
- Actuel : **smooth** (via `settings.conf`)

#### **6. Layouts (`conf/layouts.lua`)**
- Algorithme : **dwindle** (master/slave)

#### **7. Règles Fenêtres (`conf/windowrules.lua`)**
Applications flottantes avec taille fixe :
- TUI : nmtui, bluetui, pavucontrol, blueman, nm-editor…
- Utilitaires : calculatrice, mission center, satty, share-picker
- PiP : automatique (pinned, sans focus)
- Exceptions : suppression maximize requests, XWayland ghosts

#### **8. Règles Calques (`conf/layerrules.lua`)**
Flou derrière les interfaces : waybar, walker, spotlight, quickpanel, rofi, swaync, wlogout

#### **9. Workspaces (`conf/workspaces.lua`)**
- Scratchpad spécial : gaps_out=60 (feuille flottante)
- Exemples de pinning commentés

#### **10. Raccourcis Clavier (`conf/keybinds/`)**
**Système** :
- `SUPER+SPACE/A/CTRL+RETURN/V/E` → Spotlight (Walker)
- `SUPER+I` → AI chat panel
- `SUPER+CTRL+S/K/M/P` → Settings / Keybindings / Monitors / Power
- `SUPER+N/SHIFT+N` → Notifications / DND
- `SUPER+CTRL+W/SHIFT+W` → Wallpaper picker / Random / Light/Dark
- `SUPER+CTRL+B` → Waybar toggle/restart
- Toggles : animations, gamemode, nightlight
- Session : lock (`SUPER+L`), reload (`SUPER+R`)

**Fenêtres** : focus, move, resize, float, group

**Workspaces** : switch, move, scratchpad

**Screenshots** : capture, annoter, OCR

**Media** : volume, luminosité, lecteurs (OSD)

**Switches** : capot (`LID_SWITCH_HANDLING=true`)

#### **11. Autostart (`conf/autostart.lua`)**
Services lancés au démarrage :
- Plumbing : systemd-env, portals, polkit, curseur
- Desktop : wallpaper-daemon, theme-restore, apps-config, waybar, notifications, OSD, deskpet (optionnel), quickpanel, resident-menus, welcome
- Launcher : elephant + walker-service
- Idle/batterie : idle.sh, battery-alert.sh

#### **12. Personnalisation (`conf/custom.lua`)**
Fichier pour overrides personnels (non trackés)

---

### **🎨 Thèmes & UI**
- **Fontes** : Google Sans Flex (UI), JetBrainsMono Nerd (mono), CaskaydiaCove Nerd (icons)
- **Taille texte** : 12px, rayon UI : 12px
- **Opacité UI** : 0.72
- **Skin** : `default` (option `encre` pour look main-drawn)
- **Chaton** : gribouille (deskpet)

---

### **🔧 Scripts & Outils**
Scripts dans `hypr/scripts/` :
- Launcher, menus (power, settings, wallpapers, themes), wallpaper-daemon
- Notifications, OSD, quickpanel, resident-menus
- Toggles (animations, gamemode, nightlight)
- Screenshot, battery-alert, lock, idle

---

### **📊 Waybar**
Généré par `waybar/build.py`, modules dans `waybar/modules/`, styles dans `waybar/style/`.

# =============================================================================
#  settings.conf — THE single place for every user-tweakable value
# =============================================================================
#  Read by:
#    * Hyprland (hypr/lib/settings.lua parses this file)
#    * every shell script (they `source` it through hypr/scripts/lib.sh)
#    * the theming engine (fonts / radius are injected into every template)
#
#  Syntax: shell-compatible  KEY="value"  lines. Comments start with '#'.
#  Only $HOME and ${HOME} are expanded on the Lua side, so keep values simple.
#
#  Runtime toggles (animations, blur, gaps, gamemode, monitor profile) are
#  saved in ~/.local/state/inkpaw/toggles.conf and OVERRIDE these values.
# =============================================================================

EDITOR_GUI="gnome-text-editor"

KITTY_OPACITY=""
KITTY_PADDING=""
# block | beam | underline
KITTY_CURSOR=""

local function floating(name, class, size)
    hl.window_rule({ name = name, match = { class = class }, float = true, center = true, size = size })
end

-- Picture-in-Picture: floating, pinned, never steals focus -------------------------
hl.window_rule({
    name  = "pip",
    match = { title = [[^([Pp]icture[-\s]?[Ii]n[-\s]?[Pp]icture)(.*)$]] },
    float = true,
    pin   = true,
    focus_on_activate = false,
    no_initial_focus  = true,
    suppress_event    = "activate",
})

-- Ignore maximize requests from apps (kitty re-opening maximized…) -------------------
hl.window_rule({
    name  = "suppress-maximize",
    match = { class = ".*" },
    suppress_event = "maximize",
})

-- Fix XWayland drag & drop ghosts ---------------------------------------------------
hl.window_rule({
    name  = "fix-xwayland-drags",
    match = { class = "^$", title = "^$", xwayland = true, float = true, fullscreen = false, pin = false },
    no_focus = true,
})

-- AI assistant: a tall window docked on one side (AI_SIDE, AI_WIDTH). aichat.py
-- re-sends this rule at each opening with the exact geometry of the tiled
-- area (hyprctl eval) and widens the outer gap of the workspace, so tiled
-- windows move aside; the values below are only the first-guess fallback. ----
do
    local S   = require("lib.settings")
    local gap = S.num("GAPS_OUT", 12)
    local bar = S.num("BAR_MARGIN", 6) + 41 + gap          -- the bar + its margin + a gap
    local top, bottom = bar, gap
    if S.str("BAR_POSITION", "top") == "bottom" then top, bottom = gap, bar end
    local x = S.str("AI_SIDE", "right") == "left" and tostring(gap)
              or string.format("(monitor_w-window_w-%d)", gap)
    hl.window_rule({
        name  = "aichat",
        match = { class = "^(dev.inkpaw.AIChat)$" },
        float = true,
        size  = string.format("%d (monitor_h-%d)", S.num("AI_WIDTH", 420), top + bottom),
        move  = string.format("%s %d", x, top),
        opacity = "1.0 override 1.0 override",
    })
end

-- Settings window: always fully opaque (readability over the blur) -------------------
hl.window_rule({
    name  = "hypr-settings-opaque",
    match = { class = "^(dev.inkpaw.(Settings|Welcome))$" },
    opacity = "1.0 override 1.0 override",
})
